input: The file to write (inside the project folder), the project sample rate and frame rate, the QNC data folder (computer setting voice-input.json names the microphone; without it the default input).
output: A mono 24-bit WAV of the microphone first channel at the project sample rate, its seconds and the time of day it started as HH:MM:SS:FF; a microphone that does not work at that rate is a clear error, never a resample.
specification: User 2026-10-28: recording the OFF in Media Assist Audio (AGENTS.md).
